understanding: ATOM_003 is a test-only atom on tools/test-decision-synthesis.ps1. It must add depth-routing assertions that pin a 'route split': a bare plan-refinement/DISCUSS task with no explicit high-stakes marker stays Standard; an explicit [[HIGH-STAKES]] marker yields High-Stakes; broad architecture/design yields Deep. The fail-loud intent is that escalation must be driven by an explicit marker or genuine architecture wording, never by mere refine/discuss phrasing. Critically, the operator_review_gate orders ATOM_003 to be GREEN before ATOM_004 (the lib/decision-depth.ps1 narrowing) may start, and the file ends with `exit 1` when pass!=total, so every assertion I add must pass against the CURRENT router. The classifier Get-SynthesisDepthDecision is pure/deterministic and already dot-sourced by the test (line 13), so it can be asserted directly with no LLM mock.
summary: Add exactly one new, clearly-labeled assertion block near the end of tools/test-decision-synthesis.ps1 that calls Get-SynthesisDepthDecision directly and asserts three poles via the existing Assert-True harness: (1) a procedural plan-refinement task with no marker and no architecture wording -> 'Standard'; (2) the same text prefixed with [[HIGH-STAKES]] -> 'High-Stakes'; (3) a broad design/redesign-pipeline task -> 'Deep'. All three are green against the current lib/decision-depth.ps1, so the file still exits 0 (smoke/ParseFile pass) and ATOM_003 is green before ATOM_004, while the split fails loudly if a future change escalates a bare refinement above Standard, drops [[HIGH-STAKES]], or stops routing architecture Deep.

decision_atoms.statement: Assert against the pure classifier Get-SynthesisDepthDecision (already dot-sourced), not the full Invoke-SynthesisPipeline or Get-SynthesisRouteDecision.
decision_atoms.reason: It is the deterministic depth router the atom is about; it needs no LLM mocks, no config (synthesisMode.enabled), and no scratch artifacts, giving the most atomic, robust, reuse-only test of routing depth.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Does not exercise the end-to-end route() gate (route=true/false), so the 'Standard stays on normal path' wiring is only proven indirectly.

decision_atoms.statement: Pin a three-pole split (Standard / High-Stakes / Deep) rather than a single Standard assertion.
decision_atoms.reason: The fail-loud contract is contrastive: escalation must come from the explicit [[HIGH-STAKES]] marker or genuine architecture wording, not from refine/discuss phrasing. Three poles encode exactly that and catch both over-escalation and accidental collapse-to-Standard.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Three assertions instead of one is slightly more surface, but all reuse Assert-True and add no new layer.

decision_atoms.statement: Choose the 'stays Standard' input WITHOUT literal обсуди/discuss/architecture keywords so it is green against the current router.
decision_atoms.reason: The operator gate requires ATOM_003 green before ATOM_004; the current router escalates literal обсуди/discuss to Deep (that is precisely what ATOM_004 narrows). A procedural refinement (>160 chars, no trigger keywords) deterministically lands Standard today and after ATOM_004.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: ATOM_003 therefore does not directly assert ATOM_004's literal-discuss narrowing; it guards the poles and against keyword creep, deferring the narrowed-keyword assertion (a coverage gap I flag below).

decision_atoms.statement: Reuse the existing Assert-True / $script:pass / $script:total / `exit 1` harness and the existing ParseFile+smoke run as the test of the test.
decision_atoms.reason: reuse-only / no-new-layers: the file's terminal `if ($script:pass -ne $script:total){ exit 1 }` already IS the smoke/exit gate, and keeping the block syntactically valid satisfies ParseFile. No new helper, no new file.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Counting new assertions into pass/total means any mistaken expectation immediately reds the whole suite — acceptable and intended (fail-loud).

decision_atoms.statement: Defer the literal-обсуди/discuss-stays-Standard hard assertion to when ATOM_004 lands, rather than adding it red now.
decision_atoms.reason: That input routes Deep under the current router; asserting Standard now would red the suite and violate the green-before-ATOM_004 gate. ATOM_004's own acceptance ('ATOM_003 tests pass; explicit high stays high; architecture stays Deep') is exactly the pole-stability ATOM_003 already guards.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: ATOM_004's core behavioral flip is not auto-asserted by ATOM_003; closing that needs either ATOM_004 to add the assertion (but it is constrained to lib/decision-depth.ps1) or a follow-up test atom — surfaced as a risk.

assumptions: ATOM_003 is committed and must pass (exit 0) against the CURRENT lib/decision-depth.ps1, before ATOM_004 starts, per operator_review_gate.do_not_start.
Get-SynthesisDepthDecision is the canonical depth classifier, is pure/deterministic (no LLM), and is already available via the line-13 dot-source of lib/decision-depth.ps1 in the test.
'ParseFile + smoke' means the file parses with the PowerShell parser and the smoke run prints SYNTH_TEST PASS=N/N and exits 0.

The depth router operates on raw task text and has no special [[DISCUSS]] handling; a procedural plan-refinement with no обсуди/discuss/architecture keyword currently routes Standard, while literal обсуди/discuss currently routes Deep (the over-eager escalation ATOM_004 fixes).
The test is expected to run without synthesisMode.enabled, so asserting Get-SynthesisRouteDecision.route is config-dependent and is left out of the minimal version.

risks.risk: ATOM_003 does not directly assert ATOM_004's literal-обсуди/discuss-stays-Standard narrowing, leaving that behavior unguarded by an automated assertion at green time.
risks.mitigation: Anchor the two stable poles ([[HIGH-STAKES]]->High-Stakes, architecture->Deep) so ATOM_004 cannot break them silently; add the narrowed-keyword assertion in the change that lands ATOM_004 or as a follow-up test atom; rely on the named operator review gate for the interim.

risks.risk: A chosen 'Standard' input could unintentionally trip a trigger keyword (e.g. an architecture/strategy/high-stakes-domain term) and red the suite, breaking the green-before-ATOM_004 gate.
risks.mitigation: Use a keyword-free procedural phrasing >160 chars (avoids isSmallTask and short-Simple paths); traced through all five classifier branches; verify by running ParseFile + the smoke test before commit.

risks.risk: Asserting rationale strings or exact wording would make the test brittle to benign router-message edits.
risks.mitigation: Assert only the depth bucket literals ('Standard'|'High-Stakes'|'Deep') returned by Get-SynthesisDepthDecision, not rationale text.

risks.risk: Hashtable access or case sensitivity on the returned depth could cause a false failure.
risks.mitigation: Read $decision.depth (PS hashtable member access works) and compare against the exact case-correct literals the classifier returns; no ToLower on the comparison.

minimal_version: One labeled block (e.g. '=== Depth-routing route split (ATOM_003) ===') inserted after Assert-True is defined and before the cleanup/verdict. It calls Get-SynthesisDepthDecision three times and uses the existing Assert-True: (1) Get-SynthesisDepthDecision -Text '<procedural plan-refinement, no marker, no architecture wording, >160 chars>' -> depth -eq 'Standard'; (2) same Text prefixed '[[HIGH-STAKES]] ' -> depth -eq 'High-Stakes'; (3) Get-SynthesisDepthDecision -Text 'Design a new caching architecture and redesign the synthesis pipeline structure for the read path' -> depth -eq 'Deep'. No new functions, files, or config. All three pass on the current router (green before ATOM_004); the terminal exit-code gate provides the smoke check; the file stays parseable for ParseFile.
advanced_version: Add, still reuse-only: (a) a Get-SynthesisRouteDecision assertion that the Standard pole yields route=$false ('standard task stays on normal path') to prove Standard is not pulled into synthesis (guarded so it only runs/asserts when Test-SynthesisModeEnabled is true, else skipped, to avoid config coupling); and (b) a literal-обсуди/discuss plan-refinement case captured NOW as a non-failing diagnostic (Write-Host the observed depth, not counted in pass/total) documenting that it currently routes Deep, to be promoted to a hard 'Standard' assertion in the same change that lands ATOM_004. Tradeoff: the diagnostic is a weaker guard until promoted, and promotion couples this test's green state to ATOM_004 — so it is kept out of the minimal version to preserve the strict green-before-ATOM_004 ordering and the one-verifiable-change atomicity rule.
